confidence_notes: No cost-of-living index covers Hampi, so food and drink rest on traveller-guide ranges from web searches: thali about INR 100, tourist cafes about INR 300-400 per person, beer about INR 150-200, cafe coffee about INR 80-150. Beer is sold mainly on the north bank, because alcohol is officially restricted near the temple bazaar. No cappuccino, cocktail or wine prices were found. Coffee is inferred from the cafe-coffee range. Cocktail and wine glass are set at roughly 2x local beer, and one nightlife guide cites about USD 4 for a cocktail vs USD 2 for a beer. Beer is bottled, not draft. INR was converted at an assumed rate of about 92 per USD (not searched). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no listings checked. They sit near typical levels with slight July low-season softening, and the 3-star tier is the least certain. The FX figure was taken from RBA page content returned by a search.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close database comparable. Used Hampi and Hospet traveller-guide price ranges plus general knowledge of low-cost Indian backpacker and heritage towns (e.g., Gokarna, Pushkar).
